create_bullet_client_direct: create a BulletClient instance in DIRECT mode for headless physics simulation
create_bullet_client_gui: create a BulletClient instance in GUI mode for visual physics simulation
set_additional_search_path: set the additional search path for loading URDF and SDF asset files
load_urdf_model: load a URDF robot model file into the active BulletClient simulation scene
load_sdf_scene: load an SDF scene file into the active BulletClient simulation scene
get_num_bodies: get the number of rigid bodies currently loaded in the simulation scene
run_multiple_scenes: run multiple independent BulletClient simulations side by side with separate scenes
review_multiple_scenes: review the multipleScenes script that demonstrates parallel BulletClient simulation instances
summarize_bullet_client_api: summarize the BulletClient API for creating and managing physics simulation clients
test_load_urdf_sdf: test loading URDF and SDF files into separate BulletClient simulation instances
